title: brokersre-ib-gateway event (log contract v2): one line of the container's stdout and of events/events.jsonl
description: Backward compatible with v1 for a reader that ignores unknown keys: the five v1 keys are unchanged; boot_id and seq are added. A reader must ignore keys it does not know.

ts.description: UTC timestamp, ISO-8601 with milliseconds and Z suffix

msg.description: Human-readable text. Never a raw IBC or Gateway log line and never a credential.

data.description: Optional facts of this event as a flat object of strings, so a reader does not parse msg. Never a credential, a username or a full account id. container_start: gateway_version, channel, ibc_version, ibc_release, trading_mode, instance. config_rendered and config_custom: config_hash (16 hex, fingerprint of the non-secret configuration), trading_mode, read_only_api, auto_restart_time, time_zone.

boot_id.description: Identity of one container start: 16 lowercase hex characters. Absent only when no boot id is known (an event emitted before the log volume was usable).

seq.description: Position of this event among the events of its boot_id, counted across every process of the container without gaps. Absent when the event could not be written to the log volume.
